title: Supplement to Ruling No. NY 889466 on the tariff                  classification of "white moulding"
text:
NY 889466
                         Supplement No. 1

                         October 25, 1993

CLA-2-19:S:N:N7:228

CATEGORY:  Classification

TARIFF NO.:   1901.90.9095

Ms. Kathleen Crawford
BDP International, Inc.
1017 4th Avenue
Lester, PA  19029-1813

RE:  Supplement to Ruling No. NY 889466 on the tariff             
     classification of "white moulding"

Dear Ms. Crawford:

     This is a supplement to Customs Ruling No. NY 889466 dated
September 2, 1993.

     The ruling incorrectly stated the applicable tariff subheading for the
merchandise, at the heading line for the "Tariff No.," and in the body of
the letter.  The correct tariff subheading for the white moulding is
1901.90.9095, HTS.  The verbal description for the articles provided for
in this subheading, as stated in the penultimate paragraph on page one, is
correct.   

     This supplement should be presented whenever Ruling No. NY 889466 is
presented.
      

                                   Sincerely,

                                   
  
                                   Jean F. Maguire
                                   Area Director
                                   New York Seaport
